Which earned more net income in its latest fiscal year, Apple or Microsoft? Give both figures.
I'll pull the latest net income figures for both companies at the same time!
thinking: Let me fetch net income data for both Apple and Microsoft simultaneously.

content:
Here are the latest reported net income figures straight from each company's 10-K filing:

| Company | Fiscal Year End | Net Income |
|---|---|---|
| **Microsoft** | June 30, 2026 | **$133.75 billion** |
| Apple | September 27, 2025 | $112.01 billion |

**Microsoft earned more**, surpassing Apple by approximately **$21.7 billion** — roughly 19% higher than Apple's figure.

A couple of notes to keep in mind:
- The two fiscal years **don't perfectly overlap** (Microsoft's FY ends in June, Apple's in September), so they cover slightly different time periods.
- Both figures are **as reported** in their respective 10-K filings and are not adjusted for inflation.

Despite Apple being the larger company by market capitalization for much of recent history, Microsoft has pulled ahead on net income in these latest fiscal years, driven largely by the rapid growth of its Azure cloud and AI-related businesses.
